quick_start: For most features, you only need three commands: **Context -> Prompts -> Review**. Add Research, Plan, and Eval for complex or critical features.

scenario_routes.goal: Add PDD to an existing codebase
Fix a prompt that isn't working
Check if my project setup is complete

scaffold.when_to_use: Starting a brand new project from scratch

init.when_to_use: Adding PDD to a project that already has code

context.when_to_use: Before writing prompts, or when the project changes

research.when_to_use: Before building to clarify the problem and evaluate approaches

plan.when_to_use: When a feature spans multiple files, modules, or phases
plan.produces: Phased implementation plan with prompt chain strategy

prompts.when_to_use: When you're ready to write the actual feature prompt

update.when_to_use: When a prompt isn't producing good results
update.inputs: The failing prompt plus what went wrong

review.when_to_use: When AI generated code and you want to verify it
review.inputs: Generated code, pasted or in files

eval.when_to_use: After committing, to track prompt reliability
eval.next_step_template: Update the prompt if quality drops

status.when_to_use: When you want to check project health

help.when_to_use: When you want to see available commands
